overview.text: Today's developments showcase significant progress across foundational models, agent training methodologies, and infrastructure evaluation. In vision and multimodal systems, WeLM-Image integrates multimodal understanding with text-to-image generation, editing, and synthesis, while mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B advances image-text-to-text capabilities. For agent development, Harness-S introduces sibling harness learning to improve generalizable agent training, and TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench enables the evaluation of agents rebuilding websites through browser exploration. Additionally, BestRand addresses benchmark evaluation bottlenecks by offering stable and low-cost benchmark compression, matching full-benchmark results with small subsets. In industry and tooling developments, privacy and security discussions arose after Claude Code sent user email addresses to websites, and local execution gained traction as users ran Qwen 3.8 27B on laptops to interpret model weights. Furthermore, METR published an independent assessment evaluating AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic, highlighting ongoing efforts to measure the impact of artificial intelligence on research workflows.

entries.title: WeLM-Image: A Unified Image Generation Model towards Visual Intelligence
entries.summary: We present WeLM-Image, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis.
entries.why: WeLM-Image integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction editing, and multi-reference synthesis.

entries.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
entries.summary: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns.
entries.why: Harness-S leverages sibling harness evolution properties for more generalizable agent training and failure repair.

entries.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
entries.summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results.
entries.why: BestRand provides stable and low-cost benchmark compression by evaluating models on small subsets.

entries.title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
entries.why: Claude Code sends user email addresses to external websites, raising important privacy and security concerns.

entries.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
entries.summary: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved.
entries.why: Decoupled predictive decision making uses a shared conditional predictor for resolving agent deployment observations.

entries.title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
entries.summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf.
entries.why: Explores the transition from autonomous agents to cognitive symbionts for augmenting human intelligence.

entries.title: Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation
entries.summary: LiDAR is a critical sensor for autonomous driving and robotics, yet it remains vulnerable to adverse conditions such as fog, rain, transparent objects, and low-reflectance surfaces.
entries.why: Advances real-time full-waveform LiDAR transformers using intensity-guided token reduction and physics-aware augmentation.

entries.title: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B
entries.why: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B brings new image-text-to-text capabilities to the open transformers ecosystem.

entries.title: TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench
entries.summary: Can AI agents rebuild websites through browser exploration? · Python
entries.why: TIGER-AI-Lab/WebsiteBench tests whether AI agents can successfully rebuild websites through browser exploration.

entries.summary: Türkçe metinlerdeki yapay zeka izlerini (AI slop, translationese, çeviri kokan cümle mimarisi ve TDK hatalarını) temizleyen Agent Skill ve Humanizer paketi. · Python
entries.why: yucezerey/turkish-anti-ai-skill cleans artificial intelligence traits and translation errors from Turkish text.

entries.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
entries.summary: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.
entries.why: Cult.fit utilizes Codex to help internal teams build tools, move faster, and alter operational workflows.

entries.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
entries.summary: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.
entries.why: Australian universities are expanding ChatGPT access to integrate artificial intelligence into teaching and learning.

entries.title: METR: Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026
entries.summary: Executive summary From August 12 to October 29, 2026, METR staff performed a high-access evaluation at Anthropic to assess the degree to which AI is accelerating AI R&D.
entries.why: METR provided an independent assessment evaluating the degree to which artificial intelligence accelerates research at Anthropic.

entries.title: Quoting Paul Ford
entries.summary: The web browser is very, very, very powerful software for applications, and the cost of accessing that power is going down seemingly every day. — Paul Ford, The Web Is More Than Enough Tags: browsers, paul-ford, web-development
entries.why: Paul Ford highlights that web browsers remain powerful application software as access costs continue to decrease.

entries.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
entries.summary: Yesterday's hot paper was Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, and Omar Khattab.
entries.why: Demonstrates that local models running on laptops can natively read and write neural network weights.
